newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones News/Retrieval makes move to Web.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones News/Retrieval makes move to Web.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co Inc said Tuesday its Dow Jones News/Retrieval online business research and news clipping service will start migrating to the World Wide Web this summer.
News/Retrieval's move to the Web will be done in phases, with the company's publications library and Dow Jones CustomClips, a custom news-alerting service, the first two services to move to the Web.
Later this year, enhanced versions of News/Retrieval's company and industry data as well as quotes and market data components will make the shift.
The Dow Jones topics will be modified and updated on a regular basis. The overall offering of topics will increase rapidly throughout late 1997 and 1998, the company said.
Dow Jones News/Retrieval is part of the interactive publishing division of Dow Jones.
